question: Which of the following Vedas is also called "Book of Songs", "Veda of Mantras" or "Yoga of Songs"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samveda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Samveda" is an ancient Hindu text and one of the four main Vedas of Hinduism.

 It is a collection of tunes and chants, and is also called the "Book of Songs", the "Veda of Chants" or even the "Yoga of Songs".

 It is basically the words of "Rigveda" set to music.

 The Gandharvaveda deals with various aspects of Saundasau Ryashastra including art forms like music, dance, poetry, sculpture, erotica etc. It is related to the Samaveda.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rigveda:**

 
 
• The Rigveda is the oldest of the four Vedas and one of the most important texts in the Hindu tradition.
 
• It is a large collection of hymns in praise of the deities, which are chanted in various rituals.
 
• Ayurveda is the Upaveda of Rigveda.
 
 
 
• **Atharvaveda:**
 
 
• The Atharvaveda is commonly referred to as the "Veda of magical formulas".
 
• All the routines of life are described in detail in this Veda.
 
• It consists of the three fundamental Upanishads – the Mundaka Upanishad, the Mandukya Upanishad and the Prasna Upanishad – and is known as the Veda of magical formulas.
 
 
 
• **Yajurveda:**
 
 
• The text in the Yajurveda ("worship knowledge" or "ritual knowledge") consists of ritual worship aphorisms, mantras and chants directly involved in worship services.
 
• Yajurveda was composed by Ved Vyas.​
